title: Discrepancy bound is nonnegative
statement: Let $X \times Y$ carry a finite probability space $\mu$, let $g : X \to Y \to \mathrm{Bool}$ be a Boolean function, and let $\gamma \in \bbr$. If every rectangle $R \subseteq X \times Y$ satisfies $\abs{\mathrm{disc}_\mu(g, R)} \le \gamma$, then $\gamma \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: finite probability space μ on X × Y
Boolean function g : X → Y → Bool
|disc_μ(g,R)| ≤ γ for every rectangle R ⊆ X × Y
replaced:
If every combinatorial rectangle $R \subseteq X \times Y$ satisfies
$|\mathrm{disc}_\mu(g,R)| \le \gamma$, then $\gamma \ge 0$.
